rationale: The source cases share a real daemon migration pattern, but a nearby counterexample requires excluding vocabulary-only matches.

narrowed_entry.title: Bound daemon MCP promotion to transport migrations
narrowed_entry.summary: Apply daemon MCP guidance only when the task is migrating a per-reload stdio server to a healthchecked local HTTP endpoint.
narrowed_entry.statement: When an MCP migration replaces per-reload stdio launch with a singleton local HTTP daemon, preserve rollback and exclude docs-only daemon configuration work.
non_scope: Cases that mention daemon configuration but do not involve MCP transport migration.
known_breakers: Counterexample case case_daemon_config_docs_only must remain excluded.
